name: TOB AI Prompt
description: Prompt text lives here, editable without a deploy, instead of hardcoded in Python. `language_override` is deliberately optional: leave it blank for the normal case (one robust prompt with a dynamic 'respond in {language_name}' instruction appended at call time); set it only for a task/language pair that genuinely needs different wording, not just a different output language. Named language_override, not language — a field literally named `language` is a Frappe reserved default key that gets silently auto-populated from the site's default language even when never explicitly set, which defeats the whole point of 'blank means language-independent' (found live, not guessed: seeded rows came back with language='en' despite install.py never setting it).

fields.label: Language Override
fields.description: Leave blank for the language-independent default prompt (recommended). Only set this for a task/language pair whose prompt genuinely needs different wording, not just a different response language.
